title: Practising after finishing a hole
question: After finishing a hole, which types of practice are allowed on the green, and where are you not allowed to practise from?

choices.text: Practising extra putts on the green.
Practising extra chips on or just beside the green.
Playing practice shots from a bunker beside the green.
Practising putts or chips unless banned by Local Rules.

explanation: You may practise extra putts or chips on or near the putting green after completing a hole, unless local rules ban it. You can't practise from a bunker.
